records.title: Assumed dockage rates: seasonal $/ft by dock, transient $2.50/ft/night
records.caveats: Round numbers set for the demo, priced on the slip length class. Not a Buffalo rate card, a quote or a market survey.

records.title: Assumed berth depth and shore power
records.caveats: Round demo numbers: deeper at the start of each dock run, about 1.5 ft shallower at its far end; 50 A outlets on slips of 35 ft and over, 30 A everywhere. Not a survey, soundings or a utility plan. Fit verdicts built on them are illustrations, not berth-fit or navigation advice.

records.title: Simulated lake conditions: calm day and SW gale with seiche
records.caveats: Shapes chosen to illustrate a wind setup at the east end of Lake Erie and the slosh that follows (a 14 h period and the amplitudes are demo values), plus berth exposure and fixed-deck heights by dock. Not a NOAA gauge record, an NWS forecast or a survey. Verdicts built on them are illustrations, not navigation or berth-fit advice.

records.title: NWS, Marine Weather Services: Great Lakes (NOAA PA 98053)
records.caveats: Publication date not recorded in this build. Defines a Gale Warning as forecast winds of 34 to 47 knots, the exposure no-fit line used here. It gives no numeric small craft threshold, so the 20 kt tight line is an assumption.

records.title: Simulated staff dock walks and dock checks
records.caveats: Fictional staff identity checks, including “verified” demo decisions.
